captions.detailed: A short-travel dropper seatpost designed for compact bicycle frames, featuring a dark grey outer tube and a telescoping inner post. A small collar ring with an integrated horizontal locking lever sits at the top of the outer tube, while a tilting clamp head at the post's crown holds a black racing-style saddle. The inner post moves vertically along a prismatic joint, the collar lever rotates on a revolute joint, and the saddle assembly tilts on a revolute joint at the clamp head.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a short-travel bicycle dropper seatpost with an integrated saddle. The design must feature a telescoping inner tube sliding inside an outer tube, a horizontal locking collar lever at the transition, and a tilting saddle clamp holding a racing saddle with dual rails.
captions.factory: Construct the outer tube and telescoping inner post using concentric cylinders. Model the collar and locking lever assembly by combining a small ring cylinder with a rectangular block and a thin cylindrical handle, then register a revolute joint for the lever. Build the saddle clamp by extruding a bracket shape, attach it to the post crown with a revolute tilt joint, and construct the saddle shell using a tapered box lofted along the longitudinal axis, supported by two parallel cylindrical rails.
